answer: A new identity locks a 60 credit corroboration bond and claims work on the mesa board, naming two independent sources. Snapshots are fetched by raven couriers and sealed to the identity key with a crystal seal; the board accepts only matching seals from sources unused that epoch. Each fake needs two fresh sources, so the kth fake pays 60 plus two 25 fees, 110 credits, and 1,000 fakes cost 110,000 with no discount. Honest identities pay 110 once and recover the bond after a clean epoch. Rented sources fail: reuse hits the one-per-epoch cap, and one crystal seal across keys burns both bonds.
